en.title: Shortest Processing Time for Rate-Limited Requests
en.description:
There are n requests, each taking 1 time unit, and requests[i] in the string gives the region the request belongs to. You may reorder the requests freely and insert idle time; two requests from the same region must be separated by at least minGap full idle time units. Find the shortest time needed to finish all requests.

This problem uses the standard input/output format compiled by CSWork. The gap semantics are established by the official examples of Amazon #175, which has the same statement; the three illustrative examples below are taken from #175.
en.input: The first line contains n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000); the second line contains a lowercase string requests of length n; the third line contains minGap (0 ≤ minGap ≤ 100).
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The first three illustrative examples come from Amazon #175, which has the same rules, and make clear that minGap is the number of idle time units between requests of the same type.
hints: Let f be the highest frequency and c the number of types that reach it; the answer is max(total tasks,(f−1)(minGap+1)+c).
